Now part of 1Password, we're building the next generation of secure access for people, systems, and AI agents. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Senior Product Manager - Apono Apono is now part of 1Password, expanding secure access governance for the AI era Read More Menu Why Apono Agentic Platform Cloud-Native Access Governance Just-in-Time and Just Enough Privileges Cloud Privileged Access Cloud Identity Governance Access Threat Detection & Response Access Discovery and Remediation Use cases Achieve Zero Standing Privileges Break-glass Secure Database Access Secure Non-Human Identities Ensure Compliance Resources Integrations Platforms Databases Context See all Documentation Getting Started Architecture Trust Center Resource Center Datasheets Solutions Compliance Case Studies Guides Checklists Event Apono Blog Apono joins 1Password to help govern access for people, systems, and AI agents See all Partners Partners Become a Partner Register a Deal Customers Company About Meet the team Careers Contact Us Login Book a demo Back Senior Product Manager Location: TLV Department: Product Management Employment Type: Full-time Experience Level: Senior Workplace Type: Hybrid Description We are shaping the future of secure cloud access by enabling organizations to adopt just-in-time, least-privilege access across their cloud environments. Our platform empowers engineering and security teams to balance productivity with compliance by delivering identity-aware, policy-driven access at scale. Trusted by enterprises worldwide, we are redefining how modern organizations think about identity, entitlements, and security in the cloud, including how humans, machines, and AI agents get access to the systems they need. About the Role We're seeking a tech-savvy Senior Product Manager to own one of our product domains, a core area of the Apono platform with its own cross-functional squad, shaping how organizations grant, control, and prove access across their cloud environments. You will set its direction and ship against it continuously, turning complex access and security challenges into products people enjoy using, and working directly with customers and prospects to make sure you are solving the right problems. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of security, DevOps, and AI, with genuine ownership from day one. If you are excited about building with AI rather than around it, this is the opportunity for you. Responsibilities Own a product domain end to end: set the vision, strategy, and roadmap, and lead a cross-functional squad that ships and iterates continuously. Set the direction for how AI shows up in your domain: where it creates real customer value, the quality and trust bar it must meet, and how it sharpens your own craft. Decide what gets built, then get it built: prioritize from customer feedback, data, and market input, then turn those into clear requirements, a sequenced backlog, and the trade-offs with engineering that keep each sprint delivering. Partner closely with Product Design to turn complex challenges into intuitive experiences that drive adoption. Meet enterprise-grade security and compliance standards without slowing developers down. Measure what you ship: define success metrics and use product analytics to judge impact, adoption, and customer value. Take your product to market: land launches with customer success and marketing, drive adoption, and act as its evangelist inside and out. What We're Looking For 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, building technical products for technical users (developers, DevOps, IT, or security), including at least one startup. Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered capabilities, and genuine curiosity about where the technology is heading and what it changes about how products get built. Data-driven and close to your users: you define success metrics, work with product analytics, and stay in regular direct contact with users and with design. Strong technical foundation: comfortable with cloud environments, APIs, and modern SaaS architectures, and able to hold your own in a design discussion with engineers. A bias for shipping: continuous, incremental delivery alongside developers in Agile teams, and comfort cutting scope to keep momentum. Excellent communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to influence without direct authority. Fluent English, written and spoken. An advantage: background in security, identity and access management, cloud infrastructure, DevOps tooling, or enterprise compliance. Why You'll Love This Job Ship AI into a real enterprise product. Apono is investing seriously in agentic access, so this is production work rather than a side experiment. Own a mission-critical domain at the core of DevOps and cloud security, with direct influence over where it goes next. Join a rapidly growing company where your decisions visibly move the product, the business, and the direction of the category. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. jobs.title: Staff Developer
jobs.description: Staff Developer - Apono Apono is now part of 1Password, expanding secure access governance for the AI era Read More Menu Why Apono Agentic Platform Cloud-Native Access Governance Just-in-Time and Just Enough Privileges Cloud Privileged Access Cloud Identity Governance Access Threat Detection & Response Access Discovery and Remediation Use cases Achieve Zero Standing Privileges Break-glass Secure Database Access Secure Non-Human Identities Ensure Compliance Resources Integrations Platforms Databases Context See all Documentation Getting Started Architecture Trust Center Resource Center Datasheets Solutions Compliance Case Studies Guides Checklists Event Apono Blog Apono joins 1Password to help govern access for people, systems, and AI agents See all Partners Partners Become a Partner Register a Deal Customers Company About Meet the team Careers Contact Us Login Book a demo Back Staff Developer Location: TLV Department: R&D Employment Type: Full-time Experience Level: Senior Workplace Type: Hybrid Description At Apono, we empower organizations to securely operate in the cloud by aligning operations and security around access management. Our platform enables Just-In-Time and Just-Enough access across complex cloud environments, helping engineering teams move faster while reducing risk. Now part of 1Password, we're building the next generation of secure access for people, systems, and AI agents. At Apono, we are on a mission to bridge the operational security gap in access management, simplifying businesses' journey to the cloud through a commitment to innovation and excellence. Our team is made of passionate professionals who thrive on collaboration to solve complex problems, guided by our founders & leadership group with decades of proven expertise. We are seeking a Staff Developer to join our team and take a lead role in shaping the architecture, evolution, and reliability of our systems core services. You will directly shape Apono's technical direction, keeping our architecture aligned with company strategy while pushing forward what's possible in access management and engineering excellence. This role means owning a roadmap that raises the bar on quality, scalability, and security across our platform, as we bridge the operational security gap for organizations running in the cloud. What you can expect: Shape the architecture and long-term technical direction of core services powering Apono's platform. Own complex, ambiguous initiatives end-to-end, from problem definition through rollout, spanning one or more teams and systems. Break down large, undefined problems into a coherent execution plan, and drive that plan to completion. Partner with product, design, and other engineering teams as a technical authority, translating ambiguity into clear architectural decisions. Balance rapid iteration with long-term system health, scalability, and security. Raise the bar for engineering standards, code quality, observability, and operational excellence across the org. Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, technical deep-dives, and pairing. Evaluate new technologies and propose architectural improvements that shape how Apono builds going forward. Leverage AI-assisted engineering workflows to multiply your own impact and the team's. See your technical decisions directly shape the platform's ability to scale with the business. Requirements 8+ years of experience as a backend software developer, with a track record of owning large-scale production systems. Proven experience architecting and evolving distributed systems, not just building within them. Deep experience with cloud-native architectures (microservices, Docker, Kubernetes) at scale. Strong systems thinking - able to reason about trade-offs across performance, reliability, and security. Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-team technical initiatives from ambiguity to delivery. A track record of raising technical standards beyond your immediate team. Ability to balance deep technical ownership with business and product outcomes. Nice to have Hands-on experience in identity and access management. DevOps or platform engineering technical leadership background. In-depth experience with cloud service providers, mainly AWS. Strong security mindset. Experience mentoring engineers into senior or staff-level roles. Apply to this job Back Discover, manage, and monitor cloud access on a single platform.
